prompts.cobra: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single creature reference for Meshy image-to-3D, Thai Native Online RPG, matching a polished soft hand-painted anime MMORPG animal set. Create exactly ONE beautiful original Thai rice-field cobra, a level-two ranged poison enemy. Full body isolated on a plain warm light-grey studio background, no text, no platform or props. Broad clear shapes, stylized PBR sculpt, smooth organic anatomy, restrained matte scale detail, earthy dark olive-brown back, ochre cream belly, subtle muted jade hood markings. One natural cobra head, exactly two eyes, closed relaxed mouth, broad symmetrical expanded hood flowing smoothly into the neck. Raised anterior third of the body in a readable defensive S curve, lower body resting on the ground in ONE open gently serpentine curve trailing backward and to the side, one tapered tail fully visible, with substantial separation between adjacent bends. Body is a single continuous smooth tube from head to tail with no intersections, no branching, no knots and no stacked coils. Neutral balanced stance for rigging, elevated front three-quarter view so the face, hood, belly and full ground-level body curve are all visible. Head faces camera-left; entire tail in frame. Soft even studio light, very faint contact shadow. Charming but dangerous, coherent with a chestnut stylized boar, red-gold junglefowl and olive rice-field crab. Avoid limbs, horns, extra heads, dragon anatomy, overly large fangs, tongue, armour, jewellery, photorealistic scale noise, glassy or metallic skin, extreme perspective and baked black shadows.
prompts.monkey: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single creature reference for Meshy image-to-3D, Thai Native Online RPG. Create exactly ONE beautiful Thai pig-tailed macaque (ลิงกัง), a level-two agile melee enemy. Polished stylized 3D anime MMORPG animal sculpt with soft hand-painted textures, coherent with a chestnut wild boar, gold-red junglefowl and olive paddy crab. Full body isolated on a plain warm light-grey background; no props, text, pedestal or costume. Natural adult macaque proportions, compact sturdy torso, warm tawny/chestnut fur in broad groomed tufts, paler cream throat/chest, dark swept-back crown tuft, small rounded ears, muted warm pink-tan muzzle and face, amber-brown expressive eyes. Face is monkey anatomy, not human or ape. Exactly four correctly jointed limbs: two slightly longer forelimbs with elbows bending naturally backward and two hindlimbs with natural knees and ankles. Balanced neutral quadrupedal weight-bearing stance, all FOUR hands/feet separately visible and planted, hands under shoulders and feet under hips, no crossed limbs. Each hand has FIVE short naturally curved digits including an opposable thumb; each hind foot has FIVE toes including an opposable big toe, with no extra digits and no backward wrists. Exactly ONE short thick pig-like curved tail attached to rump, no longer than half the torso length, entirely visible behind the body. Front three-quarter view facing camera-left, arms and legs separated from the torso, small empty gaps for clean topology and rigging. Closed mouth, relaxed alert expression, no visible teeth. Soft even studio light and only a faint contact shadow. Broad colour shapes and smooth readable silhouette; avoid long prehensile tails, gorilla arms, humanoid hands, human face, extra limbs or digits, floating feet, jewellery, armour, fine fur noise, black baked shadows and photorealism.
